_comment: 2016 counterpart of dijet_mg_pythia8_2018_minimal_rho_pairsplit_allsyst.json. Systematics-grade minimal_rho production on the 2026-08-06 pair_split fiducial (the processor default since 5f098fb: pT floors, |y| < 2.4, dphi12 > pi - 200/ptavg, no asymmetry cut, no trijet-priority veto). all_syst passes systematics=None so every weights_obj variation is filled (pu, l1prefiring, Luminosity, and pdf/Q2muF/Q2muR/isr/fsr on the madgraphMLM samples) and the full 61-entry jet-systematic set runs (nominal + JER/JMS/JMR up/down + both directions of all 27 split JES sources). Measured cost of the JES loop on a local chunk: 2.8x wall time. Also carries the per-jet kinematic validation hists across the full systematic axis -- these are the per-year AN-25-039 validation plots. QCD madgraphMLM HT bins (RunIISummer20UL16NanoAODv9, 8 HT bins (HT100to200..HT2000toInf), TuneCP5_PSWeights, 350 files). Era plumbing for 2016: JEC Summer19UL16_V7_MC / Summer19UL16_RunFGH_V7_DATA, JER Summer20UL16_JRV3_MC, lumi 16.8 fb^-1, golden JSON Cert_271036-284044_13TeV_Legacy2016_Collisions16_JSON.txt, prescales/ps_weight_JSON_2016.json. The fileset qualifier that selects this era's datasets is set by notebook_utils.HADRONIC_ERAS_MC; the processor re-derives the same IOV from the DAS name, so nothing here needs an explicit IOV key.
